title: 혈압을 다시 확인하는 짧은 진료실 만남
origin: agent-owned independent testcase; not requester-owned anchors
full_case_rule: Every gate must be visible and complete; partial_is_fail; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS. User acceptance is separate and pending.

gates.relation: A clinician and patient share a readable routine clinical encounter within a consulting-room setting.
A broad cuff completely wraps the same patient's bare upper arm with its lower edge above the elbow; the connected forearm is supported palm-up on a table.
One uninterrupted hose route is visible from the cuff connector to the digital monitor socket; both endpoint joins and intervening route coexist in the frame.
The clinician's open hand is beside the monitor and separate from the measuring arm while both people face one another.
The central clinician's face is readable and resembles the supplied face/hair reference in the bob, fringe, eye and facial impression.
